# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.7.1 - 2026-11-04

- First version: PagerDuty remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Endpoint and header format taken from the vendor's repository (`PagerDuty/claude-code-plugins`).
- Only the MCP server is included. The vendor's slash commands (pre-commit risk scoring, skill builder) are not.
- The vendor repository is Apache-2.0. See the License section.
